text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text:
...Haha. Look at me, I actually finished 
my debut race...!

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text:
Totally. I'm seriously exhausted. My legs 
are completely swollen and sore.

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text: ...Still, though.

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text:
Make sure you give me even better training 
when we get back.

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text:
Looks like... after all, I really do want 
to win.
choice_data_list: Let's do our best to win.

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text: Yeah. Win, win, and keep on winning.

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text: I wanna get super hyped up...!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
And as I walked through the underground 
tunnel with Tosen Jordan—

text_block_list.name: Reporter A
text_block_list.text:
So, you're planning to enter a 
Junior-class GⅠ as well?

text_block_list.name: Umamusume A
text_block_list.text:
Yes! Though I'm still discussing with my 
Trainer which specific race to enter...
choice_data_list:
Looks like she's in the middle of an 
interview.
Looks like she's being interviewed, huh?

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text: ...Heeh~, an interview, huh?

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text: Trainer, aren't there any requests for me?

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text: Right~.
choice_data_list:
From now on, though, they'll just keep on 
coming!

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text:
! ...Shut up. I don't need that kind of 
encouragement.

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text: ...Still.

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text:
If you wanna make it big, you've gotta 
show real skill so the press comes 
flocking, right? Like winning a GⅠ or 
something.

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text: A goal... A goal, huh~. ...Yeah.

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text:
Might not be bad. So, if we're doing that, 
which race should it be?

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Prompted by Tosen Jordan, I consider 
potential GⅠ races. To make the most of 
her legs—

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
It is one of the highest stages in the 
Junior Class. It will be a tough race, but 
the opponents are all fellow Junior Class 
runners. In that case, there is a 
chance...

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text: ...Hmm.

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text:
"...An Umamusume debuting this year. A 
promising girl... at Hanshin..."

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text:
Wah!? Jordan is reading a racing 
magazine!?

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text:
"...Isn't that pretty normal for any 
Umamusume who's debuted?"

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text:
But up until now, any magazine you were in 
was always fashion-related, wasn't it, 
Jordan?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text: ...Is there something you'd like to know?

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text: It's not that I wanna know, but...

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text:
Like, everyone's watching this. Even the 
really strong Umamusume. So I will too.

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text: ...Just thought I'd check it out.

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text: Fufu, that's a great attitude.

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text:
Way to go, Jordan! You're the absolute 
best! Totally insane!

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text: Whoa, Helios!?

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text: Hugs, hugs!☆ Palmer, you too!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text:
All right, good girl, good girl! Jordan, 
that was awesome--!!

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text:
W-Wait... That's so embarrassing! 
...Geez!!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
"Tosen Jordan's next goal is the Hopeful 
Stakes."
